title: The Concept of Wave Function Collapse
text:
In quantum mechanics, particles are described by a wave function ($\Psi$), which encapsulates all possible states the particle could occupy. This wave function dictates the probability distribution for various outcomes upon measurement.

The process of 'collapse' refers to the instantaneous reduction of this superposition into a single definite state when an observation is made. Before measurement, the system exists in multiple potential states simultaneously; after measurement, only one measurable outcome remains, suggesting a fundamental limit on simultaneous knowledge.
